verdict.rationale: Penpot's self-hosting lets users run it on-premise or in their own private cloud, choose where and how data is hosted, and decide who has access. Its MCP server can also be deployed without third-party clouds. Together this gives indirect control over retention because the user owns the infrastructure. However, nothing in the evidence documents explicit retention policies, deletion workflows, or data-purge controls. Missing for 10: documented retention-period settings, account/file deletion and purge guarantees, AI/MCP data-retention terms for the hosted service, and independent corroboration.
